description: This file defines the RecentlyVisitedRangesService class, which manages tracking and caching of recently visited code ranges in files for autocomplete purposes within a VSCode extension environment.

classes.name: RecentlyVisitedRangesService
classes.description: Service class to track and cache recently visited code ranges in files for autocomplete features.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the service with an IDE instance and sets up cache and post-hog initialization.

methods.name: initWithPostHog
methods.description: Configures the service based on feature flags and sets up event listeners for text selection changes.

methods.name: cacheCurrentSelectionContext
methods.description: Caches the current code range around the cursor when the selection changes, respecting security concerns.

methods.name: getSnippets
methods.description: Retrieves recent code snippets from cached files, excluding the current active file.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and clears the cache.
